[ECUC_Can_00484] Definition of EcucFloatParamDef CanMainFunctionPeriod ⌈
Parameter Name
CanMainFunctionPeriod
Parent Container
CanMainFunctionRWPeriods
Description
This parameter describes the period for cyclic call to Can_MainFunction_Read or Can_
MainFunction_Write depending on the referring item. Unit is seconds. Different
poll-cycles will be configurable if more than one CanMainFunctionPeriod is configured.
In this case multiple Can_MainFunction_Read() or Can_MainFunction_Write() will be
provided by the CAN Driver module.
